mapping.summary: Offshore oil and gas platform points in the Gulf of Mexico, with no field saying whether each is a drilling or production platform. All features get the generic platform symbol 344001.
caveats: The layer has no structure type field, so drilling, production and injection platforms cannot be told apart; all get the generic platform symbol.
Removal Date is empty for every feature, so no platform is shown as removed.
Installation Date is filled for all features but is not used for symbol choice.
